we cannot rule out that the candidates are part of the outflows

claims.hypothesis: Do the bright [C II] companions show regular rotation?
claims.experiment: 3DBarolo tilted-ring fits of J0121-[C II]-B and 4C19-[C II]
claims.result: Velocity gradients consistent with disk rotation with residuals in moment 2 and PV diagrams
claims.finding: Disk rotation detected with residuals suggesting more chaotic underlying motions

evidence.quote: detect disk rotation with residuals suggesting more chaotic underlying motions

claims.hypothesis: Do companions trigger or alter radio jets?
claims.experiment: Comparison of companion positions, encounter time scale and radio morphology
claims.result: Encounter time 10-100 Myr consistent with time since jet launch; companions on the side of compact jets or deflected jets
claims.finding: Supports the merger trigger scenario for jets (based on zeroth order arguments)

evidence.quote: This supports the merger trigger scenario for jets.

why_this_data.value: Targets chosen for multi-wavelength 3D coverage and a range of host and radio properties; [C II] is a better tracer of cold gas dynamics than AGN-affected optical lines

evidence.quote: Besides the prerequisite selection for multi-wavelength coverage in three dimensions, these four HzRGs also have a wide range of host properties and radio morphologies.
is a more reliable tracer of cold gas dynamics than the warm ionized optical lines which are affected by strong AGN

why_this_method.value: Higher robust (+2.0) used for the shallow fields to gain S/N at the cost of resolution; 14 km/s channels balance S/N, continuum coverage and channel number for dynamics

evidence.quote: This provides higher signal to noise ratio (S/N) with a trade off in spatial resolution.
The choice of resolution element is a balance among S/N, continuum coverage and a sufficient number of channels for dynamical study

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Wide [O III] components of 4C03-[O III] and J0205-[O III] could be due to jet-gas interaction or AGN impact instead of a companion

evidence.quote: Alternatively, this may suggest a strong jet gas interaction.
Another possibility is that this broad line width is due to the impact from the central AGN.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Western JWST continuum of TN J0121+1320 not used for WCS correction because it may not be associated with the radio galaxy

evidence.loc: 2.4 Astrometric alignment of NIRSpec IFU cubes
evidence.quote: this western continuum may not be the emission associated with the radio galaxy
We note that our analysis may not be complete in the sense of detecting all possible companion sources in the fields of the radio galaxies

limitations_admitted.value: Dispersion-based masses are upper limits because sizes of unresolved sources are overestimated

evidence.quote: We stress that this mass estimate should be treated as an upper limit, as the size is overestimated.

referee_caveats_inferred: Companion status of [O III] blobs rests on kinematic offsets from SINFONI-era bulk motion; outflow or illuminated debris cannot be excluded
Only four targets and two of the ALMA fields at half depth, so the 100% rate and f_MM ~ 25% are weak statistically
Low-S/N [C II] detections (3-4 sigma) have no independent confirmation of redshift

Band 8 astrometry alignment of the NIRSpec cubes depends on assuming the continuum sits at the radio core

missing_for_reproduction: ALMA line-free channels, masking and image size settings
q3dfit input configuration for the 1D and spaxel fits
Exact per-companion positions and apertures used for the 1D [C II] spectra beyond the table coordinates
Effective radii and axis ratios used in the mass formulas for each companion
No released code or analysis scripts; no machine-readable catalogue stated
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Roughly 100-300 GB (ALMA Band 8 C43-5 measurement sets for four fields plus four JWST NIRSpec IFU datasets of ~4 h each)
reproducibility.score_reason: Data sources, software versions, robust values and many fit parameters are given, and results are numeric, but imaging masks, line-free channels and q3dfit setup are not stated and no code is released.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA public status is not stated and key imaging and q3dfit settings are missing, so the main numeric results could not be redone with confidence from the paper alone.
